items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: I was working with Wilbur DeParis at the time I met Jimmy Ryans.

ctx.x: See, and he was the King Fish, himself. So we set a line up of things to Louis Armstrong and looked like Louis didn't care for that too much because Tommy called himself the King Fish. See, Wilbur DeParis was in it and Too Sweet was in it
